title: I Will Sing to the Lord

request.style: English, soul, female solo voice with deep choir, upright bass, Hammond organ, warm drums, soft piano, uplifting and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When you send forth your Spirit
They are created anew
You renew the face of the earth
With grace that we receive

[Pre-Chorus]
May the glory of the Lord
Endure forevermore
May he rejoice in his works
Who trembles the earth and more

[Chorus]
I will sing to the Lord all my life
I will sing praise to my God as long as I live
May my meditation please him
I will rejoice in the Lord

[Verse]
He looks at the earth and it trembles
Touches the mountains and they smoke
The wicked shall vanish from the earth
Sinners shall be no more

[Chorus]
I will sing to the Lord all my life
I will sing praise to my God as long as I live
May my meditation please him
I will rejoice in the Lord

[Bridge]
Bless the Lord my soul
Praise the Lord forever
His works are perfect
His presence is near

[Chorus]
I will sing to the Lord all my life
I will sing praise to my God as long as I live
May my meditation please him
I will rejoice in the Lord
